mvn -f m3/pom.xml -pl compiler/static-use -am reads every module pom of the default reactor and its profiles: a sparse worktree must check out '/m3/**/pom.xml' (1,234 poms) for the reactor gate

a review read the descriptor name org.m3jdk.compiler.staticuse as the package; the sibling convention separates the two (module org.m3jdk.compiler.<x>, package jdk.m3.compiler.<x>, coordinates com.m3:m3-compiler-<dir>), so verify.sh gained a 'siblings' gate that prints every m3/compiler module's coordinates, descriptor name, exports and packages and refuses a mismatch; branch 20261107b re-runs every gate on master 9b72a0ab831d without a rename
